{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean body mass
mean_body_mass = filtered_df['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Compute and print the number of rows
n_rows = len(filtered_df)

# Compute IQR for body_mass_g
Q1 = filtered_df['body_mass_g'].quantile(0.25)
Q3 = filtered_df['body_mass_g'].quantile(0.75)
IQR = Q3 - Q1

# Compute bounds using 1.5 * IQR
lower_mult = 1.5
upper_mult = 1.5

lower_bound = Q1 - lower_mult * IQR
upper_bound = Q3 + upper_mult * IQR

# Count values outside bounds
outliers = filtered_df[(filtered_df['body_mass_g'] < lower_bound) | (filtered_df['body_mass_g'] > upper_bound)]
n_outliers = len(outliers)

# Print all required values
print(f"Number of penguins after removing missing body_mass_g: {n_rows}")
print(f"Mean body mass: {mean_body_mass}")
print(f"Q1: {Q1}")
print(f"Q3: {Q3}")
print(f"IQR: {IQR}")
print(f"Lower bound (IQR method): {lower_bound}")
print(f"Upper bound (IQR method): {upper_bound}")
print(f"Number of outliers (by IQR): {n_outliers}")"}
